30:     }
31:

33:         std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(this->mutex);
34:         if (this->stop) {

37:

61: void Logger::run() {
62:     while (true) {
63:         std::queue<LogEntry> local_queue;
64: 
65:         {
66:             std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(this->mutex);
67:             this->condition.wait(lock, [this] {
68:                 return this->stop || !this->queue.empty();
69:             });
70: 
71:             if (this->stop && this->queue.empty()) {
72:                 return;
73:             }
74: 
75:             local_queue.swap(this->queue);
76:         }

79:             const auto& entry = local_queue.front();
80:             this->output << '[' << Logger::level_name(entry.level) << "] "
81:                          << entry.message << '\n';
82:             local_queue.pop();
